title: Consolidate the common Gallery scene descriptor
scope: Replace parallel Gallery context, catalog, asset and capability mappings with one immutable common scene descriptor consumed by the session, CLI, desktop and mobile shells.
acceptance: Each scene's stable ID, asset, name, help, controls, camera, workload flags, broad features and exact interaction requirements are declared once in a common descriptor.
Contract tests prove descriptor order, uniqueness and completeness and show catalog and CLI selection derive from it without platform-maintained scene mappings.
